aspects.description: Successful sign-in stores session; session survives reload
aspects.extraDescription: Test: login as passenger1@email.com / passenger123; enter the app with Bearer token stored. Reload; passenger remains authenticated.

aspects.description: Invalid or inactive login shows a clear error
aspects.extraDescription: Test: wrong password and passenger31@email.com / passenger123 return 401 and show a clear authentication error without sensitive details.

aspects.description: Sign-out clears the session and opens sign-in
aspects.extraDescription: Test: sign out calls logout when possible, clears local session, and navigates to `/login`. Local session is cleared even if the remote token is already invalid.

aspects.description: 401 on protected request clears session and requires re-authentication
aspects.extraDescription: Test: invalidate/expire the stored token, then trigger a protected request; session is cleared and sign-in is required again.

aspects.description: Registration creates an account and opens My claims
aspects.extraDescription: Test: register with unique valid data (password ≥ 8 chars); session is stored and `/claims` opens.

aspects.description: Registration shows client and API validation errors
aspects.extraDescription: Test: incomplete/invalid form blocked client-side with field messages; API 422 (e.g. duplicate email) shows field-specific messages.

aspects.description: Profile loads and displays current passenger data
aspects.extraDescription: Test: `/profile` loads via GET /passenger/profile and shows current name, email, phone, and address fields. Existing password is never displayed.

aspects.description: Profile update confirms success and omits empty password
aspects.extraDescription: Test: update a profile field; show returned data and a visible success confirmation. Empty/unchanged password is not sent. Optional new password ≥ 8 characters is accepted.

aspects.description: Profile shows API validation errors including non-unique email
aspects.extraDescription: Test: trigger a profile PUT 422 (e.g. email already used); field-specific messages appear next to the relevant controls.

subCriterions.name: New claim wizard and quality score

aspects.description: Wizard shows three steps with current and completed step indication
aspects.extraDescription: Test: `/claims/new` presents Where/when → Item details → Review. Current step and completed steps are clearly indicated.

aspects.description: Terminal selector shows loading while GET /terminals runs
aspects.extraDescription: Test: opening `/claims/new` shows a clear loading state while terminals are fetched; the selector is not ready as a successful list yet.

aspects.description: Failed terminals load shows error and Retry
aspects.extraDescription: Test: block or fail GET /terminals; an error is shown with a Retry action that requests terminals again.

aspects.description: Cannot continue without a terminal from a successful response
aspects.extraDescription: Test: passenger cannot advance/submit without selecting a terminal loaded from a successful GET /terminals response.

aspects.description: Where/when step validates lost_on before advance
aspects.extraDescription: Test: cannot leave Where/when without a valid lost_on. A future date is rejected and does not allow advance. (Terminal selection is marked separately.)

aspects.description: Item details step validates required category and description
aspects.extraDescription: Test: cannot leave Item details without required category (exact allowed values) and description. Optional brand, colour, and flight number may be left empty.

aspects.description: Review summary and safe return to previous steps
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Review shows a complete summary of entered values. Returning to earlier steps keeps data. Browser back/forward does not accidentally submit or wipe entered values.

aspects.description: Claim quality score recalculates live from 0 to 100
aspects.extraDescription: Test: score updates immediately when form values change using the documented point rules and is clamped to 0–100. Calculated entirely in the browser — no API call and not sent with the claim.

aspects.description: Quality score labels match documented score bands
aspects.extraDescription: Test: 0–39 Needs more detail; 40–69 Basic; 70–89 Detailed; 90–100 Excellent.

aspects.description: Worked example claim quality score equals 90
aspects.extraDescription: Test: terminal + category + brand + colour, no flight number, 85-character description with ≥12 distinct words, and today's lost_on scores exactly 90.

aspects.description: Review step shows quality score breakdown and improvement hints
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Review step shows a points breakdown and indicates which optional details could still increase the score.

aspects.description: Quality score is advisory and does not block valid submission
aspects.extraDescription: Test: with a low quality score but API-required fields valid, submit still succeeds.

aspects.description: Unfinished claim draft recoverable after reload
aspects.extraDescription: Test: leave an unfinished claim draft and reload (or reopen the browser); offer Continue or Discard and restore values when continuing.

aspects.description: Draft is not retrieved after submit, discard, or passenger change
aspects.extraDescription: Test: after successful submit or Discard, no previous draft is offered. Signing in as a different passenger does not retrieve another passenger's draft.

aspects.description: Quality score matches restored draft form values
aspects.extraDescription: Test: when a draft is continued or discarded, the claim quality score again matches the current form values.

aspects.description: Valid claim creation returns confirmation with reference code
aspects.extraDescription: Test: valid submit via POST /passenger/claims creates the claim and shows confirmation including CL-XXXXXXXX.

aspects.description: Duplicate claim submit is prevented while a request is in progress
aspects.extraDescription: Test: after clicking submit, further submit actions are blocked or ignored until the request finishes (no duplicate POSTs).

aspects.description: Confirmation modal shows claim summary with copyable reference
aspects.extraDescription: Test: after create, modal shows reference code (CL-XXXXXXXX, easy to copy), submitted status, category, terminal, and date lost.

aspects.description: Create new claim resets the wizard to the first step
aspects.extraDescription: Test: choosing Create new claim closes the modal, resets the multi-step form to Where/when, and leaves the passenger ready to file another claim.

aspects.description: Show my claims and dismiss navigate to My claims
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Show my claims navigates to `/claims`. Dismiss via Escape, close button, or backdrop does the same — not leave the finished form without confirmation.

aspects.description: Claims list shows required fields and opens claim detail
aspects.extraDescription: Test: list shows reference, category, terminal, lost date, and status; each row opens its claim detail page.

aspects.description: Claims list supports status filtering via the API
aspects.extraDescription: Test: changing the status filter requests GET /passenger/claims with the matching status query and updates the list.

aspects.description: Pagination uses API links or meta
aspects.extraDescription: Test: page navigation uses the API `links` or `meta` pagination; does not assume a single page of results.

aspects.description: Claims URL query stores selected status and page
aspects.extraDescription: Test: after selecting a status and page, the URL contains both (e.g. `?status=submitted&page=2`).

aspects.description: Reload and browser history restore the claims workspace view
aspects.extraDescription: Test: reloading the page and using browser back/forward restore the same status filter and page from the URL.

aspects.description: Changing status filter resets pagination to page 1
aspects.extraDescription: Test: with page > 1 selected, change the status filter; the list returns to page 1 and the URL page parameter updates accordingly.

aspects.description: Delayed rejected filter cannot overwrite a newer selection
aspects.extraDescription: Test: select rejected (~2s API delay), quickly switch to another status; after both complete, list and URL match the last status, not rejected.

aspects.description: Empty claims state is clear and distinct
aspects.extraDescription: Test: when the passenger has no matching claims, show an empty message that is not a loading or error state.

aspects.description: Page changes keep prior results with non-blocking loading
aspects.extraDescription: Test: moving between claim pages keeps prior results visible with a non-blocking loading indication — no incorrect empty flash.

subCriterions.name: Claim detail, withdrawal, and live refresh

aspects.description: Claim detail presents required passenger claim fields
aspects.extraDescription: Test: detail shows reference, terminal, category, brand/colour when present, description, lost date, flight when present, status, created/updated, resolution and matched-item info when available.

aspects.description: Authenticated claim detail shows clear not-found for unavailable claims
aspects.extraDescription: Test: open `/claims/:id` with an unknown or inaccessible id; show a clear not-found / unavailable message (API 404), not a blank or uncaught error page.

aspects.description: Passenger journey represents all statuses correctly
aspects.extraDescription: Test: journey covers submitted, under-review, matched, resolved, rejected, withdrawn. Rejected/withdrawn are alternative endings, not successful completion.

aspects.description: Withdraw action only for submitted or under-review claims
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Withdraw is shown only when status is `submitted` or `under-review`. It is hidden for matched, resolved, rejected, and withdrawn.

aspects.description: Withdraw asks for confirmation before sending the request
aspects.extraDescription: Test: choosing Withdraw prompts for confirmation; cancelling does not call the withdraw endpoint.

aspects.description: Successful withdraw updates claim to withdrawn and hides the action
aspects.extraDescription: Test: confirming withdraw updates the displayed claim to `withdrawn` and hides the Withdraw action.

aspects.description: Claim detail polls about every 15 seconds
aspects.extraDescription: Test: while an open non-terminal claim detail is visible, it refreshes from the API about every 15 seconds.

aspects.description: Polling does not start overlapping refresh requests
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a new automatic refresh does not start while the previous refresh request is still in progress.

aspects.description: Polling pauses when hidden and refreshes when visible again
aspects.extraDescription: Test: hide the tab/page (document hidden); automatic polling pauses. Make it visible again; a refresh runs promptly and polling resumes.

aspects.description: Polling stops for resolved, rejected, or withdrawn
aspects.extraDescription: Test: when status becomes resolved, rejected, or withdrawn, automatic polling stops.

aspects.description: Timers and pending claim refreshes are cleaned up on leave or sign-out
aspects.extraDescription: Test: leave claim detail (or sign out) while polling; no further claim GET from that page applies afterwards. Switching to another claim/route must not apply the previous page's response.

aspects.description: Status changes update journey with accessible announcement
aspects.extraDescription: Test: when status changes via refresh, journey and claim data update without full page reload and the change is announced visibly and via an accessible live region.

aspects.description: Manual refresh control works on claim detail
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a manual refresh control refreshes the open claim using the same loading handling as automatic refresh.

aspects.description: Temporary refresh failure keeps last claim with a warning
aspects.extraDescription: Test: after a successful load, force offline/block claim GET and refresh; last claim stays visible with a non-destructive warning, not a blank/full error page. Manual refresh may retry.

aspects.description: Public track works signed-out and opens result URL
aspects.extraDescription: Test: while signed out, `/track` accepts a valid CL-XXXXXXXX code and navigates to `/track/:referenceCode` showing the public track result.

aspects.description: Tracking result URL can be reloaded
aspects.extraDescription: Test: reloading `/track/:referenceCode` repeats the public lookup and shows the same tracking result.

aspects.description: Reference code input is uppercased and trimmed
aspects.extraDescription: Test: entering a code with surrounding spaces and lowercase letters is normalized (trim + uppercase) before the request; internal characters are not changed.

aspects.description: Public track uses only the public endpoint and shows no personal data
aspects.extraDescription: Test: tracking uses GET /claims/track/{referenceCode} only (no authenticated passenger endpoints) and does not display passenger personal data.

aspects.description: Unknown code shows not-found and allows another search
aspects.extraDescription: Test: invalid/unknown code produces a clear claim-not-found result and allows another search.

aspects.description: Public result uses the same live journey and refresh behaviour
aspects.extraDescription: Test: tracking result uses the same journey presentation and 15-second refresh rules as authenticated detail, via the public endpoint only.

aspects.description: Required path-based History-mode routes open the correct pages
aspects.extraDescription: Test: `/login`, `/register`, `/track`, `/track/:referenceCode`, `/claims`, `/claims/new`, `/claims/:id`, and `/profile` open the correct pages using framework History mode. Navigation uses path URLs (e.g. `/claims`), not hash routing (`#/claims`).

aspects.description: Default `/` redirects by authentication state
aspects.extraDescription: Test: `/` redirects signed-out users to sign-in and signed-in users to My claims.

aspects.description: Authenticated routes are guarded and restore after sign-in
aspects.extraDescription: Test: open `/claims`, `/claims/new`, `/claims/:id`, or `/profile` while signed out → navigate to sign-in; after successful login, return to the originally requested URL. Reload keeps the same route content.

aspects.description: No staff or admin UI is exposed
aspects.extraDescription: Test: passenger UI has no staff/admin desk, items, matching, dashboard, or elevated-privilege navigation.

aspects.description: SPA code organization and maintainability
judgementScoreDescription: Unstructured code; hard to follow routes, API calls, or components
Basic page split but inconsistent naming or duplicated API/auth logic
Clear structure for routes, pages, and API usage with reasonable separation of concerns
Well-organized SPA with reusable auth/API patterns and maintainable naming

aspects.description: Passenger-facing visual design and layout quality
judgementScoreDescription: Looks unfinished or like an admin tool; weak hierarchy and inconsistent layout
Basic passenger layout works but visual hierarchy and consistency are limited
Clear passenger-service design with good hierarchy, spacing, and consistent components
Polished airport passenger portal: strong hierarchy, consistent UI, and readable status presentation

aspects.description: Loading, empty, success, and error states are clearly distinct
judgementScoreDescription: States missing or confusing across pages
Some states exist but are inconsistent or easy to misread
Four states are generally clear and consistent on main flows
All four states are unmistakable portal-wide with helpful messaging

aspects.description: Accessibility of forms and interactive controls
judgementScoreDescription: Poor keyboard use, missing labels, or no visible focus
Basic labels exist but keyboard/focus/error association is incomplete
Forms are keyboard-usable with labels, focus states, and associated errors on main flows
Consistent keyboard access, clear focus, labeled controls, and accessible status updates

aspects.description: Responsive layout without horizontal scrolling
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at ~360px and desktop widths, main pages remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

aspects.description: Status is not communicated by colour alone
aspects.extraDescription: Test: claim statuses use text/labels (or equivalent non-colour cues), not colour alone.
